Predicting the amount of rainfall in a region based on various cues is a ______ problem.

For polynomial regression, which one of these structural assumptions is the one that most
affects the trade-off between underfitting and overfitting:

options.B: Whether we learn the weights by matrix inversion or gradient descent
options.C: The assumed variance of the Gaussian noise
options.D: The use of a constant-term unit input

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - The polynomial degree

questions.stem_text:
As the number of training examples goes to infinity, your model trained on that data will
have:
Which among the following prevents overfitting when we perform bagging?

options.A: The use of sampling with replacement as the sampling technique
options.C: The use of classification algorithms which are not prone to overfitting
options.D: The practice of validation performed on every classifier trained

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - The use of weak classifiers
